previous_statement: Correction addressing ch-be7fac67b9d62de2. The verifier is right and node 1.8 is not a valid qed. For W in {U,V}, the allowed outer-compression lemma yields only ||T_W(I_{B_W})-u_W|| <= C_out*t with u_W=Co^{A_R}_{P_W^R}(P_W^R), while def-four-corner-merging-datum requires ||T_W(I_{B_W})-P_W^R|| <= rho. The exact decomposition T_W(I)-P_W^R=(T_W(I)-u_W)+(u_W-P_W^R) leaves the uncontrolled term ||u_W-P_W^R||. Neither Co^2=Co nor dagger compatibility implies u_W=P_W^R or an O(t) estimate, and the approximate-unit axioms cannot be invoked on P_W^R without a permitted premise that P_W^R lies in the compressed range. Thus nodes 1.3--1.7 do not prove the datum; node 1.8 is retracted as a closing inference, and the root cannot be completed from the seven allowed externals. A mathematically valid future repair must add a separately validated, shard-permitted corner-unit estimate ||Co_P(P)-P|| <= K_unit*(delta+epsilon), then choose C_cross >= max{1,C_nest,C_out+K_unit,2*C_ca} and reduce e_cross to its threshold.
